name: Cilydd

attributes.attribute: Welsh hero and father of Kulhwch
son who seeks Olwen with aid from Arthur
cousin of Cilydd and king of Camelot

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Cilydd was a Welsh hero. As the hero Kulhwch's father, he urged the young man to search for his true love, the maiden Olwen. He sent Kulhwch to King Arthur of Camelot, his cousin, to ask for help.

okr.objective: Cilydd directs his son toward the court of Arthur so Kulhwch can win Olwen.
key_results: Cilydd is a Welsh hero and the father of Kulhwch.
Kulhwch seeks help from King Arthur at Camelot.
Olwen is the true love that Kulhwch tries to win.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
